description: Create, read, edit, share or delete the user's saved menus (undated; don't ask for dates). Reads: list, get. Writes (blocked on read-only accounts): save, add_entry, fill, set_entry, delete_entry, copy, rename, share. delete is permanent: ask, then confirm=true. Show the whole menu after get/save. Returns the menu {id, title, type, entries} or {menus:[...]}.

clear_recipe.description: set_entry: detach the recipe; the slot goes back to the dish name

confirm.description: Must be true for delete, only after the user agreed

entries.description: save: [{weekday, slot or course, recipe_id or title, label, servings, kind: recipe|needs_recipe|no_cook}]. label = the user's dish name (e.g. "Salad") shown above its recipe link; several entries with the same label/slot/day are one dish with several recipes. Pass back every label from get when re-saving.

label.description: add_entry/set_entry: the user's dish name (e.g. "Salad") kept above the recipe link; set_entry with only label renames the dish

type.description: save: week (Mon-Sun), day (breakfast/lunch/dinner) or occasion (by course)

update_list.description: add_entry: true also adds its ingredients to the menu's shopping list

visibility.description: share: private or family (shared with the user's group)

name: manage_menu
title: Menus
